signature_ttp.technique: Modify Program, reprogramming safety controller logic

provenance: US Treasury sanctions October 23 2020 (sm1162) naming TsNIIKhM in connection with TRITON; Mandiant attribution reporting October 2018; MITRE ATT&CK for ICS.
what_this_card_cannot_tell_you: That the intrusion failed. It did not. The attackers reached and modified the safety controllers. A fault during deployment triggered a fail-safe shutdown, which is how the malware was found. Mandiant assessed that shutdown as inadvertent, at moderate confidence.

sector_targeting: Targeted by protocol, not by sector

signature_ttp.technique: Unauthorized Message: Command Message, via native industrial protocols

provenance: CISA advisory AA22-103A, April 2022, issued jointly with DOE, NSA and FBI; Dragos PIPEDREAM reporting.
what_this_card_cannot_tell_you: Who this is. The toolkit was found before it was used, which is unusual and good, but it means attribution rests on capability analysis rather than on observed operations against a victim. This is the only card in my set where the tooling is better documented than the operator, and putting a confident name on the card would misrepresent that.

signature_ttp.technique: Supply Chain Compromise, trojanised ICS vendor software downloads

provenance: CISA AA22-083A (Mar 2022), 2011-2018 energy campaign; CISA TA18-074A (Mar 2018); DOJ indictment returned Aug 26 2021, unsealed Mar 24 2022, three FSB Center 16 officers.
what_this_card_cannot_tell_you: What the access was for. Public reporting describes years of persistent presence in energy sector networks with no destructive effect, which reads either as patient pre-positioning or as collection that never had an effect phase. The card picks a tier; intent is unresolved.

aka: the Colonial Pipeline ransomware affiliate operation
sector_targeting: Selected by ability to pay, not by sector

signature_ttp.technique: Data Encrypted for Impact against IT systems, with OT consequences arising indirectly
signature_ttp.id_note: No ICS technique applies: the encryption hit IT systems only. The OT consequence followed from an operator containment decision, not from a control-system effect.

provenance: CISA and FBI joint advisory AA21-131A, May 2021; Colonial Pipeline public statements and subsequent congressional testimony.
what_this_card_cannot_tell_you: That this was an OT attack. It was not. DarkSide encrypted IT systems; Colonial halted the pipeline to contain the incident while assessing how far the compromise reached. CISA and FBI reported no indication the ransomware directly affected OT, which is a finding at the time, not a guarantee.

sector_targeting: Any facility running internet-exposed Unitronics PLCs

signature_ttp.technique: Internet Accessible Device, default credentials on exposed controllers

provenance: CISA advisory AA23-335A, December 1 2023, on IRGC-affiliated actors exploiting Unitronics PLCs, issued with FBI, NSA, EPA and INCD.
what_this_card_cannot_tell_you: Which tier this actor really belongs in. It brands itself hacktivist and the bar was low: exposed PLCs with default passwords. But CISA attributes the campaign to IRGC-affiliated actors. A capability tier is one field and this actor needs a paragraph.
